## Rule established from demonstrations and solved recurrences

This is a global role-based palette remapping; grid geometry and dimensions remain unchanged. In the random two-color variants, identify the more frequent (field) and less frequent (marker) colors: map the less frequent color to 0, and map the more frequent color to the original less frequent color.
